passages.title: 세미나 자료 공유 메일
passages.passage:
From: Julia Grant
To: Marketing Department
Subject: Slides from Monday's Seminar

Hi everyone,

Thank you to those who attended the social media seminar on Monday. As promised, the slides are attached to this email.

A recording of the talk will be posted on the team drive by Wednesday. If you would like the speaker's book list, just reply to me and I'll forward it.

Best,
Julia

questions.q: What is attached to the email?
questions.exKo: the slides are attached to this email라고 명시합니다.

questions.q: What will be posted by Wednesday?
questions.exKo: A recording ... will be posted on the team drive by Wednesday에서 확인됩니다.

questions.q: How can staff get the book list?
questions.exKo: just reply to me and I'll forward it라고 안내합니다.

passages.title: 봄맞이 창문 청소 안내 메일
passages.passage:
From: Building Office
To: All Tenants
Subject: Window Cleaning Next Week

Dear tenants,

Outside window cleaning will take place next Monday through Wednesday. Workers will hang from ropes outside the building, so you may see them at your window.

Please keep windows locked during this period and remove items from window ledges. No entry into offices is required. Work stops if it rains and continues the next clear day.

Building Office

questions.q: What will happen next week?
questions.exKo: 다음 주에 건물 외부 창문 청소가 진행된다는 안내입니다.

questions.q: What should tenants do?
choices: Keep windows locked and clear the ledges
questions.exKo: keep windows locked ... remove items from window ledges라고 요청합니다.

questions.q: What happens if it rains?
choices: Work stops and continues the next clear day
Work is canceled for the year
questions.exKo: Work stops if it rains and continues the next clear day에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 주말 전력 점검 공지
passages.passage:
POWER SHUTDOWN NOTICE

Electricity in the building will be shut off this Saturday from 7 a.m. to 3 p.m. for yearly safety testing. Lights, elevators, and wall outlets will not work.

Please turn off computers before leaving on Friday. The server room has backup power, so email and shared drives will stay online. Weekend workers should plan to work from home.

Facilities Team

questions.q: Why will power be shut off?
questions.exKo: for yearly safety testing이 정전의 이유입니다.

questions.q: What should staff do before leaving Friday?
questions.exKo: turn off computers before leaving on Friday라고 안내합니다.

questions.q: What will stay online during the shutdown?
questions.exKo: 서버실은 예비 전원이 있어 이메일과 공유 드라이브는 유지됩니다.

passages.title: 탕비실 커피머신 교체 공지
passages.passage:
COFFEE MACHINE UPDATE

The old coffee machine in the 3rd-floor break room has been replaced with a new model. The new machine offers ten drink choices, including hot chocolate and tea.

Use is free, but please bring your own cup — paper cups are no longer provided, to reduce waste. A short how-to video is posted on the intranet. Report any problems to extension 350.

Admin Team

questions.q: What is new in the break room?
questions.exKo: 3층 탕비실 커피머신이 새 모델로 교체되었다는 공지입니다.

questions.q: Why are paper cups no longer provided?
questions.exKo: to reduce waste라고 이유를 밝힙니다.

questions.q: Where can staff learn how to use the machine?
questions.exKo: A short how-to video is posted on the intranet에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 실내 골프 연습장 광고
passages.passage:
SWING CITY — INDOOR GOLF FOR BUSY PEOPLE

Practice your golf swing rain or shine! Swing City has 12 screen golf booths open from 6 a.m. to midnight.

Weekday morning rates start at just $15 per hour, clubs included. Beginners can book a 30-minute lesson with a pro for $20. Two blocks from City Hall Station, Exit 4.

questions.q: What is Swing City?
questions.exKo: 실내 스크린 골프 연습장을 홍보하는 광고입니다.

questions.q: What is included in the weekday morning rate?
questions.exKo: $15 per hour, clubs included라고 명시합니다.

questions.q: How much is a beginner lesson?
questions.exKo: a 30-minute lesson with a pro for $20에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 열쇠·도장 즉석 제작 광고
passages.passage:
QUICK KEYS & STAMPS

Need a spare key or a name stamp? We make them while you wait — most keys in 5 minutes, stamps in 20 minutes.

Office orders welcome: we engrave door signs and desk nameplates too. Show this ad for 10% off any order over $10. Open Monday to Saturday inside Union Market, near the north entrance.

questions.q: What does the shop make?
questions.exKo: 열쇠, 도장, 명패 등을 즉석 제작하는 가게 광고입니다.

questions.q: How long does a stamp take?
questions.exKo: stamps in 20 minutes라고 안내합니다.

questions.q: How can customers get 10% off?
choices: By showing the ad on orders over $10
questions.exKo: Show this ad for 10% off any order over $10에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 폐교 활용 창업 공간 기사
passages.passage:
DALEVILLE — An elementary school that closed three years ago has reopened as a startup center. Twelve young companies now rent former classrooms at low cost.

The gym hosts monthly markets where the startups show their products to residents. "The building is full of life again," said project director Han Solmin. Applications for the five remaining rooms open next month.

questions.q: What is the article about?
choices: A closed school reopened as a startup center
questions.exKo: 폐교가 창업 지원 공간으로 다시 문을 열었다는 기사입니다.

questions.q: What happens in the gym?
questions.exKo: The gym hosts monthly markets라고 명시합니다.

questions.q: What opens next month?
questions.exKo: Applications for the five remaining rooms open next month에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 직장인 아침 운동 모임 기사
passages.passage:
PORTVIEW — Every Tuesday and Thursday at 7 a.m., about 50 office workers meet in Harbor Park for a free 30-minute workout before work. The group, called Morning Movers, started with just six friends a year ago.

A local sports store sponsors the group and provides free water. Organizer Dan Foley says the secret is simple: "Short, fun, and done before your first meeting."

questions.q: What is Morning Movers?
questions.exKo: 출근 전 무료 아침 운동 모임에 관한 기사입니다.

questions.q: How did the group begin?
choices: With six friends a year ago
questions.exKo: started with just six friends a year ago라고 설명합니다.

questions.q: What does the sponsor provide?
questions.exKo: provides free water에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: USB 놓고 간 물건 문자
passages.passage:
Ryan Tate (4:12 P.M.)
Hi Chloe, did I leave a silver USB drive in Meeting Room 5? I can't find it anywhere.

Chloe Bennett (4:15 P.M.)
Let me check... Yes! It was next to the whiteboard.

Ryan Tate (4:16 P.M.)
Phew! It has today's client files. Could you hold onto it?

Chloe Bennett (4:17 P.M.)
Sure, it's in my top drawer. I'm here until 6.

Ryan Tate (4:18 P.M.)
I'll come by at 5. Thanks a million!

questions.q: What did Mr. Tate lose?
questions.exKo: a silver USB drive를 찾고 있습니다.

questions.q: Why is the USB drive important?
questions.exKo: It has today's client files라고 설명합니다.

questions.q: Where is the USB drive now?
questions.exKo: it's in my top drawer에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 화상회의 링크 오류 문자
passages.passage:
Zoe Kang (10:58 A.M.)
Hi Victor, the video call link for the 11 o'clock meeting isn't working. It says 'meeting not found.'

Victor Reed (10:59 A.M.)
Sorry! I moved the meeting to a new room. Sending the new link now.

Zoe Kang (11:00 A.M.)
Got it — I'm in. The client hasn't joined yet.

Victor Reed (11:01 A.M.)
I'll email them the new link right away. Start with the agenda if I'm two minutes late.

questions.q: What problem does Ms. Kang report?
choices: The meeting link does not work
questions.exKo: 11시 회의 링크가 열리지 않는 문제를 알리고 있습니다.

questions.q: Why did the link fail?
choices: The meeting was moved to a new room
questions.exKo: I moved the meeting to a new room이라고 설명합니다.

questions.q: What will Mr. Reed do for the client?
questions.exKo: I'll email them the new link right away에서 확인됩니다.
